# Court Hearing Information

# Court Hearing Information (When & Where)

### Criminal Cases

If you have an attorney, check with your attorney about when and where you should appear.

Check your ticket, citation, subpoena or any paperwork you were given to see when and where to appear.

You can get information on when and where a case will be heard from the following sources:

- Look-Up/Confirm Criminal & Civil Cases Scheduled Next 7 Days
- Kiosk Computer Help Stations (see Kiosk Computer Help Stations)
- Call the Municipal Court Assignment Commissioner's office at (513) 946-6250, between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM, weekdays.
- Visit the Assignment Commissioner's office in room 117 of the Justice Center, 1000 Sycamore St., Cincinnati, Ohio or room 255 of the Courthouse, 1000 Main St., between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM, weekdays.
- Call the Clerk of Courts office at (513) 946-6010, 24 hours a day, every day of the year.

### Civil Cases

If you have an attorney, check with your attorney about when and where you should appear.

Check your subpoena or any paperwork you were given to see when and where to appear.

You can get information on when and where a case will be heard from the following sources:

- Look-Up/Confirm Criminal & Civil Cases Scheduled Next 7 Days
- Kiosk Computer Help Stations (see Kiosk Computer Help Stations)
- Call the Municipal Court Clerk's office at (513) 946-5700, between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM, weekdays.
- Visit the Municipal Court Clerk's office in room 115 of the Courthouse, 1000 Main St., between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM, weekdays.

### Kiosk Computer Help Stations

These public, touch screen computers allow access to the criminal and civil case schedules for the next seven days for both Municipal and Common Pleas courts in Hamilton County. (See Look-Up/Confirm Criminal & Civil Cases Scheduled Next 7 Days.) These kiosks are located near the elevators at either end of the main entrance of the Courthouse and outside of Room 255 in the Courthouse.
